districts.name: Rock, rap and fast food
districts.blurb: Leans toward Joe Rogan, Travis Scott, Burna Boy, Metallica, Harley-Davidson and McDonald's, away from gaming and Friends.

districts.name: Pop divas and Chanel
districts.blurb: Over-indexes on Beyoncé, Taylor Swift, Shakira, Coldplay, Friends and Chanel, with less interest in gaming and podcasts.

districts.name: Indie music and Drag Race
districts.blurb: Strongest for Phoebe Bridgers, Radiohead, Lana Del Rey, Tyler, the Creator, Drag Race and Patagonia.

districts.name: K-pop, Uniqlo and dance
districts.blurb: Heavily over-indexes on Uniqlo, Fred again.., BTS, McDonald's, Olivia Rodrigo and Travis Scott.

districts.name: Activewear and outdoor brands
districts.blurb: Leans toward Lululemon, Patagonia, The North Face, Minecraft, Call Her Daddy and Coldplay.

districts.name: Football, Afrobeats and Gucci
districts.blurb: Over-indexes on Lionel Messi, Burna Boy, Call of Duty, LeBron James, Gucci and Shakira, away from indie rock.

districts.name: Video games and sports
districts.blurb: Strongest for Call of Duty, Fortnite, Minecraft and Joe Rogan, plus LeBron James and Lionel Messi.
